scope: One fixed center10second dataset clip ×15official prompts, new official inference; original-versus-edited comparison, no seven-method baseline rerun.

configuration.implementation: Unmodified official run_sample_exp.py; output saving instrumented for validation
configuration.known_paper_code_difference: Official energy mask divides target Mel energy by mixture Mel energy; paper Eq 9 divides by target+non-target energy. Code baseline retained.

task_mapping_note: Official infer_edit_stem uses substring vocals2/drums2/bass2; all others default to other. Retained unmodified even when a task prefix such as bass_guitar2 does not match bass2. Labels follow official task names, not manual correction.
features: Same original music CLAP checkpoint, sample mean stereo downmix, Julius resampling, exact original LPAPS reduction and CQT2010 trajectory PCC. New example outputs evaluated; old750metrics untouched.
